propositions: _assemble_context_uncached silently swallows list_tickets and show_ticket exceptions, leaving children empty and has_children False, causing container-scoped DET checks to return trivial passes instead of signaling incompleteness
PlanContext lacks fields to track that hierarchy enumeration or per-child fetches failed; this incompleteness status cannot be threaded through finalize_verdict call sites

finalize_verdict verdict derivation does not check for hierarchy load failures before defaulting to pass, violating the parent epic AC that plan review cannot produce clean pass when hierarchy was loaded incompletely

plan_review_coach receives a minimal reconstructed PlanContext without hierarchy data and cannot source hierarchy_incomplete flag from real pctx, requiring YAML threading of outputs from precheck step

All five finalize_verdict call sites (two in workflow_ops, three in gate_dispatch) must receive hierarchy_incomplete/hierarchy_incomplete_detail via coverage dict, but plan_review_coach YAML inputs block lacks the required fields
drift_floor verdict recomputation after drops does not account for hierarchy incompleteness, allowing INDETERMINATE to revert to PASS when BLOCK verdicts are dropped
